title: Spiral Matrix III
summary: Begin at (rStart, cStart) on an rows x cols grid facing east.
statement: Begin at (rStart, cStart) on an rows x cols grid facing east. Walk in a clockwise spiral to visit every cell, continuing outside the grid boundaries if necessary. Return the coordinates of each cell visited in order.
constraints: Start inside the grid facing east and walk an expanding clockwise spiral, continuing outside boundaries.
Return in-grid coordinates in visit order until all cells are listed.
hints: A square spiral travels lengths 1,1,2,2,3,3 in east,south,west,north order.
Simulate that infinite path and record only coordinates inside the grid.
For each step length walk two directions, then increment length, stopping after rows*cols records.
The spiral eventually encloses every finite grid cell even while intermediate positions lie outside.
editorial: The spiral eventually encloses every finite grid cell even while intermediate positions lie outside.

tests.explanation: The first eastward steps visit the only row from column zero through three.
The expanding spiral eventually records all thirty grid cells in order.
